versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-sac-new-api skill.
- Enables end-to-end deployment of the NewAPI LLM Gateway on Huawei Cloud using Terraform.
- Includes step-by-step CLI workflow for extraction, template download, variable review, deployment, and cleanup.
- Strict security: never expose or read AK/SK in output or context; user must manually edit credentials in `terraform.auto.tfvars.json`.
- Guides users through confirmation at each critical step before making infrastructure changes.
- Outputs and verification steps are standardized in JSON for consistent automation and review.
